0022600211.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-9, on a six-game losing streak and 15th in the East) visit the New York Knicks (5-4, on a three-game winning streak and 5th in the East) in a regular-season game that is the Bucks' 11th of the season. Milwaukee is 0-4 on the road, while New York is 3-2 at home, and both Gary Trent Jr. (Bucks, illness) and Josh Hart (Knicks, ankle) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost 1-2 to the Knicks, including a 127-98 loss in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026.
